name: Warikiri Kanojo ~Takarakuji Atetara Meikko to Icha Love Seikatsu ga Hajimatta~
original_name: 割り切りカノジョ～宝くじ当てたら姪っ子とイチャラブ生活が始まった～
source: Nagoya wins the lottery, after buying everything he ever desired he finds his loveless life boring, wishing for a girlfriend his niece, Mai, enter his life. Mai just so happens to be in need of money, and thus their romantic and immoral relationship full of hot incest and compensating dating begins.​
translation: 直哉中了彩票，买齐曾经渴望的一切后，却发现没有爱情的生活十分无聊。正当他渴望交个女朋友时，侄女舞衣走进了他的生活。舞衣恰好缺钱，于是，两人开始了一段交织着乱伦与援助交际的浪漫、不道德关系。
